body:
Some agent programs print warnings that don't affect the run, such as Codex's *"Model metadata for `<model>` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata…"*. Solace currently treats such a warning as the run's error and shows it in the task's notes and as the failure reason.

Solace keeps a short list of known harmless warnings and doesn't show them in task notes or as a run's failure reason. The first entry is Codex's missing model metadata warning. They stay in the run's raw log.

For agents: `board::runs.exit_error` picks the last `error` entry from the transcript, so a warning wins over the agent's last words. Filter the listed warnings out there (and anywhere else transcript errors reach notes).
title: runs: hide harmless agent warnings
